purpose: Potential answer-format cues across revised medication treatment-role MCQs; heuristic, not measured item difficulty
flags: Key answer 5+ words longer than median distractor
>=2 distractors containing words such as routine, only, every, always, without
limitations: Removal of superficial cues does not prove question is hard or clinically valid.
Some safety distinctions inherently include absence of contraindications and can be phrased clearly without word-trigger giveaways.
All 82 role questions still require independent item-level clinical and discrimination review.
